sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The mandibles are more curved in M. tensus and M. acutidens, both of which have proportionally longer heads that are not narrowed anteriorly to the same degree.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow, the antennae and labrum pale, the mandibles dark. The sides and posterior margin of the head are straight, the front slightly narrowed. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 1 as long as segments 2, 3 and 4 together; segment 2 longer than segment 3; segments 3 and 4 subequal. Labrum very large, its apex with two large rounded lobes. Mandibles long and slender, slightly incurved; each mandible bears a tooth near its base. A large rounded protuberance lies on the front of the head near the opening of the frontal gland. Anterior margin very faintly incised. Measurements (mm): head length to the tip of the nasus 1.50, head length to the antennal base 1.16, head width 1.33, antennal length 1.89, pronotum length 0.30 and width 0.67, hind tibia length 1.00, left mandible length (inexact) 1.67.

note: Adapted from the species-level description in Emerson (1928), original in English; only the soldier is described, the worker and alate are not recorded; the original marks the left mandible measurement as inexact; the description is based on 1 soldier taken from a mushroom-shaped nest of Mirotermes (Cubitermes) orthognathus; synonymy, figure numbers and localities are not translated.
